Class ProtobufMessageBuilders

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.protobuf.ProtobufMessageBuilders
@Internal public final class ProtobufMessageBuilders extends Object
Creates Protocol Buffers message builders.

Uses the ProtobufMessageFactory generated at compile time by micronaut-protobuff-processor for the message type. Factories are looked up through the message type's own class loader, and the result is cached per message class, so nothing keeps a class loader alive after its classes are unloaded.

For compatibility only, a message compiled without the processor, for example one from a shared library, falls back to calling its static newBuilder() method by reflection.

Since:
5.3.0
